column2: What the heck...!{wait}{clear}Sure, I know helping you set the world's turmoil right is important, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}But the country my brother's trying to protect matters to me too.{wait}{clear}This time I'm not listening to you. See ya!{wait}{clear}
I also think it is a very important duty. Don't worry about me. Go to the Empire.{wait}{clear}
Thanks, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. I'm relieved to hear you say that.{wait}{clear}Well, I've got to get ready.{wait}{clear}
Yes. Take care, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Oh, you followed me here?{wait}{clear}
This country's cold... It doesn't suit me.{wait}{clear}
Straight to the talks, huh... I'm off to see the emperor.{wait}{clear}
Chancellor
Grand Duke Rudiere, envoy of the King of Legrance, welcome after your long journey.{wait}{clear}His Majesty has eagerly awaited the arrival of our friend from the south.{wait}{clear}
It is an honor to meet you, Your Majesty.{wait}{clear}
Endymion
We are pleased to meet you as well, Grand Duke.{wait}{clear}
Now, Grand Duke, forgive us after you've come all this way, but His Majesty is extremely busy.{wait}{clear}What is the King of Legrance's message? Kindly keep it brief.{wait}{clear}

Yes. As my country's representative, I wish to ask Your Majesty about the Empire's southward policy.{wait}{clear}The conflict your armies are waging in the south... I ask that you tell me where it is headed, and why.{wait}{clear}
Our current policy is to reclaim lands that rightfully belong to our Empire.{wait}{clear}We would have you understand that it is no threat to your young southern nation.{wait}{clear}

Precisely.{wait}{clear}The King of Legrance's concern is understandable, but our Empire and our Emperor have no such intentions whatsoever.{wait}{clear}The glory of our new Emperor rivals even that of the holy founding emperor, the Crimson Moon King.{wait}{clear}We understand the lords' unease, but we ask that you trust in his deep mercy.{wait}{clear}Rest easy, young Grand Duke.{wait}{clear}
.....{wait}{clear}Your Majesty, what are your thoughts on the people suffering from the war?{wait}{clear}
As a ruler, we naturally take them into account. But they do not outweigh the greater cause.{wait}{clear}
Well, our next audience is fast approaching.{wait}{clear}My apologies, but we must end things here.{wait}{clear}
Do be sure to tell the King of Legrance all you've heard. That his concerns are unfounded.{wait}{clear}
Ha ha, we're counting on you.{wait}{clear}And what will you do now, Grand Duke?{wait}{clear}
It's late today, so I intend to leave the capital early tomorrow morning.{wait}{clear}

I see. What a shame.{wait}{clear}Why, there's no need to hurry home. You could take your time touring this historic capital, said to be the most beautiful on the continent.{wait}{clear}I'm sure it would be most instructive for your young country. Ha ha ha...!{wait}{clear}
What's with that chancellor? What a creep...{wait}{clear}
...I'm going back to my room to sleep. I feel sick.{wait}{clear}
Tomorrow I'm leaving early and heading home.{wait}{clear}
I want out of this country as fast as I can.{wait}{clear}
All right... Please get some good rest in your room tonight...{wait}{clear}
Yeah... I will... I'll stay put in this room tonight...{wait}{clear}
Rudi, for now, please recover from your journey.{wait}{clear}
Good evening, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
That's strange... He said he would stay put in his room...{wait}{clear}Ah...! It seems he's outside. Let's go and see.{wait}{clear}
What... What's up?{wait}{clear}
Nothing, I was just a little worried about you...{wait}{clear}What about you, Rudi? What are you doing out here at this hour?{wait}{clear}
Oh, yeah... I just couldn't sleep.{wait}{clear}
I snuck out of my room and was looking at the view here...{wait}{clear}
Phew... Say what you will, that chancellor had a point...{wait}{clear}
Our country is young and has no history...{wait}{clear}
Maybe it's only natural they look down on me.{wait}{clear}
That isn't true{n}
Don't lose heart{n}
That isn't true. Your country is a fine one.{wait}{clear}Every country has its own circumstances. But none of them should be better or worse for it.{wait}{clear}
Our country's just getting started...{wait}{clear}
From here on, all we can do is what we're able to...{wait}{clear}
You don't need to lose heart over what others say.{wait}{clear}You're proud of Legrance, aren't you, Rudi? Believe in that feeling.{wait}{clear}
Yeah... You're right.{wait}{clear}
It's just getting started... our country.{wait}{clear}
All I can do is what I'm able to...{wait}{clear}
...Hm?{wait}{clear}
